theme: Volatility family from FREE proxies -- the vol-ETP complex as a MECHANICALLY TETHERED relative-value family (daily-reset prospectus identity r_A = k*r_B), the one corner of the volatility theme not already swept.
verdict: NOISE. 0 of 38. Honest zero. The entire apparent alpha lives at lag0 (same-close fill) and is arithmetically equal to the bid-ask spread; one day of slack destroys 100% of it.
scope: research only, no orders, no money, cached free data only, no network call

mechanism.one_sentence: VIXY(+1x ETF), VXX(+1x ETN), UVXY(+1.5x ETF), SVXY(-0.5x ETF) all track ONE published index (SPVXSTR) and VIXM/VXZ both track SPVXMTR; each is a DAILY-RESET product so its NAV return over one session equals k*(index return) - fee/day exactly and path-independently, making e_t = r_A - k*r_B a pure wrapper-vs-wrapper price dislocation.
mechanism.a_priori_sign: FADE e_t -- short whichever wrapper outran its own contractual multiple. Fixed before any result was computed; the sweep is NOT sign-agnostic.
mechanism.leverage_change_handled: ProShares 2018-02-28: UVXY 2x->1.5x, SVXY -1x->-0.5x; 6 transition sessions guarded out

data.source: Yahoo chart v8 adjusted closes, cached at research/data/volterm_cache/raw/

windows.note: VXX and VXZ list 2018-01-25, so pairs containing them have a 3.9y design window; VIXY/UVXY/SVXY pairs have 10.2y

N.unevaluable_reason: SVIX and UVIX both list 2022-03-30, entirely inside the held-out window; no design window exists for them

headline.lag_convention: both prints are 16:00 closes, so lag0 (compute from close t, fill AT close t) is a zero-slack lookahead and is REFERENCE ONLY; lag1 (fill MOC t+1, earn t+1->t+2) is the HEADLINE; lag2 is the kill test

the_decisive_diagnostic.name: bounce arithmetic
the_decisive_diagnostic.claim: if the lag0 profit is the half-spread bouncing, gross profit per unit of turnover equals the round-trip half-spread
the_decisive_diagnostic.reading: lag0 gross bp per unit turnover is the same order as, and in 5 of 6 cases BELOW, the round-trip cost. The 'edge' is the spread you must pay.
the_decisive_diagnostic.rho2_to_rho5_of_residual: all within +/-0.09 of zero for every pair -- no memory past one day

rho1_gate.gate: rho1(delta s) must be > ~-0.35 (with Hurst<0.5 and ADF) or the reversion is measurement bounce
rho1_gate.confirmed_as_a_diagnostic: the two pairs the gate flags as bounce on design (VXX/VIXY -0.553, UVXY/VXX -0.450) are exactly the two with the largest lag0 Sharpes (+2.91, +3.21) and a total lag1 collapse (+0.21, +0.21). The gate would have saved this sweep.
rho1_gate.there_is_no_middle: pairs that PASS pass by having rho1 ~ -0.08, i.e. almost no reversion to harvest at all. The complex offers bounce or nothing, never slow convergence.
rho1_gate.NEW_CAVEAT_FOR_THE_PROGRAMME: rho1 is REGIME-UNSTABLE here: 4 of 6 pairs flip the gate's verdict between design and holdout (VXX/VIXY -0.553->-0.044; VXZ/VIXM -0.100->-0.525; SVXY/VIXY -0.081->-0.491; UVXY/VXX -0.450->-0.031). Recommendation: keep rho1 as a KILL test but require it in BOTH windows; a single-window rho1 is not an ex-ante certificate.

the_one_economically_legitimate_object_a.object: the Barclays VXX issuance suspension of 2022-03-14 -- creations could not arbitrage the premium, so VXX detached from VIXY. Visible as VXX/VIXY residual sd of 202 bp/day in 2022 vs 18-48 bp in every other year.
the_one_economically_legitimate_object_a.why_it_fails: negative at EVERY lag. A premium that is wide can go wider for months; fading a WIDENING structural premium loses on the way out and only pays at the collapse, which is one observation. Structural legitimacy is not sufficient -- the premium must converge on a clock you can hold through.

the_tether_is_decaying.reading: the family's whole variance is two named events (Feb 2018, Mar-Aug 2022). Outside them the wrappers track to 15-50 bp/day; SVXY/VIXY now tracks to 15 bp/day, BELOW one round trip. There is no dislocation left to fade even before significance is considered.

P_pairfade.what: one-day replication-residual fade, 6 pairs x {linear 60d causal z (+/-3 sigma clip), |z|>=2.0 threshold}

L_premlevel.what: cumulative wrapper premium M=sum(e), detrended by trailing 20d/60d mean, z over 120d, faded at |z|>=2, 5-day hold, 5 liquid pairs. A LEVEL object, so the one-day-bounce argument does not apply to it -- and it is dead anyway (best design lag1 gross +0.08)

X_crosswrap.what: ORIGINAL CONSTRUCTION: convert all four SPVXSTR wrappers to implied index return i=r/k; the four must agree on one number; fade whichever disagreed. Linear / |z|>=2 / cross-sectional rank, plus accumulated-premium levels at 20/60/120d. Index-neutral by construction.

H_horizon.what: the three most liquid pairs' one-day fade held 3 and 5 days -- the axis that separates a slow premium from a bounce

S_spec.what: specification controls COUNTED IN N. S_BETA: 120d fitted regression multiple instead of contractual k (scored +0.30/+0.16 vs contractual +0.30/+0.15 -- identical, so the fit does not beat the contract). S_LOG: log-return tether, deliberately the wrong algebra for a daily-reset product (scored -0.35/-0.51, worse than every correct-algebra formula)

controls_not_counted_in_N.reading: the theme is not a disguised long-vol beta and could not be, being spread-neutral

costs.but: per the EXECUTION-COST WALL lesson, cost is NOT what killed this. The GROSS lag1 numbers are already at zero. Charging zero basis points changes no verdict.

dead_ledger_additions: The volatility-ETP complex as a mechanically-tethered RV family: the daily-replication residual r_A - k*r_B for VXX/VIXY, VXZ/VIXM, UVXY/VIXY, SVXY/VIXY, UVXY/VXX, SVXY/VXX, faded as a 60d causal z (linear and |z|>=2), held 1/3/5 days.
The cumulative wrapper premium sum(e) detrended at 20d/60d and faded at |z|>=2.
The four-wrapper implied-index-return disagreement cross-section (linear, threshold, rank) and its accumulated-premium levels at 20/60/120d.
The fitted-beta and log-return tether specifications.

DEAD AS AN IDEA, not just as a number: 'the ETN creation halt is a free, mechanical, structurally-anchored dislocation'. It is all three of those things, it is clearly visible in the data, and fading it lost money at every lag.
what_would_change_the_answer: Intraday quotes for the vol ETPs. All numbers are close-to-close and the theme's alpha sits at lag0, i.e. inside the last minutes of the session. A 15:45->16:00 rail (this programme's L2 shape) is the only place it could live. Free data gives no intraday history for VXX/VIXY/UVXY/SVXY. Caveat: this would be a rescue attempt on a signal whose gross alpha is already zero at the only lag measurable honestly -- the EXECUTION-COST WALL says the prior on that is poor.
Real VX futures settlements -- the standing data wall from both prior vol sweeps. Not on any free keyless endpoint from this host. It would not help THIS family, whose tether never needed the curve.
Nothing else. Adding formulas to the volatility family only raises a bar that 229 formulas have already failed.
